The '''''Dark Dancer''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that served under the portion of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]] commanded by [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]]. In [[44 ABY]], when Khai [[Destruction of Tahv|defected]] from the Tribe to [[Abeloth's fleet|join]] the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]], the ''Dark Dancer'' suffered a hit and failed to respond to Khai's attempts to transmit his orders. Even though he knew the vessel might still have been loyal to him, he did not want to risk letting it survive if it was not, and ordered that his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Black Wave]]'' destroy it.<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>
